lines.text: You describe a task with a customer name, a secret path, and a half finished idea.
Now the app wants a title for it. Something short, so the board stays readable.
Many tools send your whole description to a server, just to get one short title back.
Do you really want a customer name and a file path sent off, just for a label?
Agent R Q does it differently. It writes the title with a small language model inside your browser.
The text never leaves your device. Not the customer, not the path, not one byte of it.
It even works on a flaky connection, because the model is already on your machine.
A second later the task has a tidy name: fix Acme invoice export. Short and safe.
The full description stays on the task, for your agent to read. Only you and your agent see it.
You do not have to choose between a readable board and a private one. You get both.
Your descriptions stay yours, whatever you write in them.
What would you never paste into a cloud tool? Tell us in the comments, or try it at Agent R Q dot com.
